India to send delegation to Ayatollah Khamenei's funeral

India will be represented at the funeral of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei by a delegation including the Minister of State for External Affairs and the Governor of Bihar. Prime Minister Modi was invited but will not attend. The delegation's composition and the significance of India-Iran relations are points of focus.
